npz_rescoring.tolerance_interpretation: PASS: largest channel difference is 0.00475 on a physical MSE around 368463 for Jena PAR channel; aggregate and block differences are <= 2.3e-4. Differences are float32/float64 and CSV/source precision level, not metric mismatch.

corrected_interpretation.corrected_claim: Jena seed92602 PRED_BOLT_RAW_R는 RAW_BOLT_RAW_R보다 physical MSE만 낮지만 MAE와 normalized metrics는 더 나쁘다. seed92601은 RAW_BOLT_RAW_R보다 physical MSE도 나쁘다. 두 seed 모두 RAW_R_ONLY보다 physical MSE/MAE가 나쁘다. 따라서 결론은 metric/seed tradeoff이지 전체 우위 또는 전체 열위가 아니다.

numbers.previous_v1_overstatement: Jena compressed+correction does not uniformly fail against RAW_BOLT_RAW_R. Seed 92602 PRED_BOLT_RAW_R has lower physical MSE than RAW_BOLT_RAW_R but worse MAE and normalized metrics.
numbers.correct_wording: Jena seed 92602 shows physical-MSE-only improvement over RAW_BOLT_RAW_R, but MAE and normalized metrics remain worse; both PRED_BOLT_RAW_R seeds remain worse than RAW_R_ONLY on physical MSE/MAE.

final_scope_boundary.can_claim: bounded development diagnosis completed; report_v1 CSV/figures/links numerically verified; sparse origin-pool failure source narrowed; PRED objective sometimes improves compressed path versus REC/PCA; compressed Bolt offers raw-Bolt latency reduction in measured batch8 pipelines.
final_scope_boundary.cannot_claim: independent TEST generalization; universal accuracy advantage; method-exclusive memory saving; D-only causality; physical and normalized metrics always agree; REC learned improvement under selected criterion; fair native-vs-Bolt equal-cost result.
